freeze_reason: stop methodology iteration and transition to confirmatory validation after correcting the pairwise interface to test both orientations without the unknown chronology label

pre_confirmation_amendment.reason: the spent posthoc analysis knew ABCD and therefore evaluated the known-wrong orientation; a deployable reconstruction method cannot use the unknown true chronology to choose the class to test
pre_confirmation_amendment.correction: test both i<j and j<i classes for every unordered pair; infer only the surviving orientation when exactly one class is certified impossible; abstain when neither is excluded; both excluded is invalid

spent_result_role: methodology development only; preregistered single-witness K4 result remains a scientific negative

interaction_measurement.k4_retention: four scalar witness projections per complete chronology; no K4 model-space endpoint or interaction tensors retained
interaction_measurement.target_active_lift_replay: bitwise tensor SHA256 equality to the independently replayed target endpoint

witness_bank.construction: for each candidate final stage j, form the six degree-three full-history predictions ending in j, project the target onto their convex hull, and normalize target-minus-projection to obtain u_j
witness_bank.freeze_rule: all four witnesses for a target must be fully constructed and unit-norm checked using only K3 information plus the given target endpoint before the first K4 candidate active-lift output
witness_bank.single_witness_failure_is_not_a_method_f: the frozen method uses the entire pre-K4 witness bank through an infinity-norm certificate; it does not select one witness after K4 output

certificate.hierarchy: nonnegative K-local order marginals with simplex and adjacent-level marginal consistency
certificate.pairwise_decision_rule: for each unordered stage pair {i,j}, solve both precedence classes i<j and j<i without access to the true chronology label
certificate.euclidean_soundness: because every u_j is unit norm, max_j absolute witness projection is no larger than Euclidean residual norm
certificate.solver: scipy.optimize.linprog highs proposes primal and dual values; the reported bound clips and L1-normalizes inequality duals, recomputes reduced costs, applies one simplex-minimum correction per local subset, and subtracts a floating-point guard
certificate.class_exclusion_rule: an orientation class is certified impossible only if its proof-safe Euclidean distance lower bound exceeds the elimination guard
certificate.pair_inference_rule: exactly one excluded class implies the opposite orientation; neither excluded implies ambiguity; both excluded is invalid
certificate.full_chronology_rule: full chronology is returned only if all six pair orientations are inferred and form one transitive total order
certificate.terminal_exactness_check: at K=N=4 each orientation-class local-order LP primal must match an independent complete-permutation convex-hull witness-space LP within 1e-8
certificate.label_use_rule: the frozen generating history may be used only after pair decisions are fixed, for evaluation of contradictions and full-history accuracy

theory_scope.terminal_exactness: at K=N=4, the hierarchy contains the full permutation simplex, so each property LP is exact in the retained witness-projection geometry and there is no omitted interaction tail
theory_scope.fixed_k_scaling: the hierarchy coordinate count is sum_{r<=K} P(N,r), polynomial in N for fixed K, and the number of pairwise property decisions is O(N^2)
theory_scope.exactness_below_terminal_level: for K<N, the certificate is exact for the degree-K interaction model; promotion to an exact true-endpoint claim requires an explicit omitted-interaction bound or increasing K
theory_scope.information_barrier: without additional regularity assumptions, unseen K+1 interactions cannot be universally bounded from degree-K observations alone; the hierarchy is therefore instance-adaptive rather than a universal fixed-K exact decoder
theory_scope.paper_complexity_measure: interaction certificate depth K-star is the smallest interaction level at which the requested chronology properties are certified under the applicable tail rule

confirmation_sampling_plan.selection_rule: four cyclic A/B/C/D orders and their reverses; every stage appears exactly twice in every position; fixed before any heldout output

method_change_policy: no witness construction, interaction degree, two-sided pairwise decision rule, solver correction, thresholds, target histories, or success criteria may be changed after heldout confirmation begins based on confirmation outputs
next_step: cheap-CI-test the label-blind confirmation runner and immutable four-seed workflow, freeze the final CI provenance, then launch once without intermediate adaptation
